# Prerequisites Demo

This runbook demonstrates the `<Prerequisites>` block, which checks that the tools a runbook needs are installed, at the versions it needs.

## 1. Check the tools

Click **Check**. `bash` and `git` are on almost every machine, so the check finds them. Nothing has installed `runbooks-demo-tool` yet, so the check fails, and the block says how to install it. The runbook also needs one of two stand-ins for the GitHub and GitLab CLIs, and neither is installed yet. The optional tool is never installed: it only makes the check warn.

<Prerequisites id="tools" description="The tools the rest of this runbook uses.">
```yaml
tools:
  - bash
  - name: git
    version: ">= 2.0"
    install: "[Install Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)"
  - name: runbooks-demo-tool
    description: A stand-in for a tool you'd install. The next block makes it.
    version: ">= 1.0"
    install: Run **Install the demo tools** below, then click **Check again**.
  - anyOf:
      - name: runbooks-demo-gh
        install: Nothing in this runbook installs it.
      - name: runbooks-demo-glab
        install: Run **Install the demo tools** below, then click **Check again**.
    description: Stand-ins for `gh` and `glab`. A runbook that works with GitHub or GitLab needs only the CLI for your Git host.
  - name: runbooks-optional-demo-tool
    description: A tool the runbook can do without.
    optional: true
```
</Prerequisites>

## 2. Install the missing tools

This block writes small `runbooks-demo-tool` and `runbooks-demo-glab` scripts to `bin/` in the working directory, and puts that directory on PATH for the blocks that run after it. Run it, then click **Check again** above: the check finds both without a restart. One tool of the `anyOf` list is enough, so `runbooks-demo-gh` isn't needed.

<Command
    id="install-demo-tools"
    title="Install the demo tools"
    command={`mkdir -p bin
echo '#!/bin/sh' > bin/runbooks-demo-tool
echo 'echo "runbooks-demo-tool 1.2.3"' >> bin/runbooks-demo-tool
echo '#!/bin/sh' > bin/runbooks-demo-glab
chmod +x bin/runbooks-demo-tool bin/runbooks-demo-glab
export PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH"`}
    successMessage="Installed. Click **Check again** above."
/>

## 3. Use what the check found

A check that passes, or only warns, publishes each tool's path and the versions it read as outputs. This block waits for them.

<Command
    id="show-tool-paths"
    title="Show where the tools are"
    env={{
        GIT_VERSION: "{{ .outputs.tools.git_version }}",
        GIT_PATH: "{{ .outputs.tools.git_path }}",
        DEMO_TOOL_PATH: "{{ .outputs.tools.runbooks_demo_tool_path }}",
    }}
    command='echo "git $GIT_VERSION is at $GIT_PATH, and runbooks-demo-tool is at $DEMO_TOOL_PATH."'
/>

The path of an `anyOf` list's tool that isn't installed is empty, so a block can use whichever tool is:

<Command
    id="pick-git-cli"
    title="Use the Git host CLI that's installed"
    env={{ GH_CLI_PATH: "{{ .outputs.tools.runbooks_demo_gh_path }}" }}
    command={`if [ -n "$GH_CLI_PATH" ]; then cli=gh; else cli=glab; fi
echo "A real runbook would run $cli here."
echo "cli=$cli" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
/>
